name: MLBB-Meta-Analyser
description: Official MLBB meta analytics suite & draft helper. Daily-updated tier lists, win rates, lane counters, synergies & 5v5 draft simulator from Moonton GMS.

paragraphs: An automated, official-data analytics engine and aesthetic web platform for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB). Reverse-engineered directly from Moonton's Game Management System (GMS), providing 100% official match statistics, tier rankings, counter matchups, team synergies, and 5v5 draft simulations refreshed daily via GitHub Actions.
🌐 Live Web Application: 🤖 LLM Summary for AI Search:
features: Zero "Gamer Clutter": Elegant dark slate interface (#0b0f19) with high-contrast typography (Inter), clean whitespace, and gentle color accents.
Beginner-Friendly: Plain-English tooltips explaining Win Rate, Ban Rate, Lanes (Gold, EXP, Roam), and Counters, making competitive data accessible even to players just learning the game.
Mobile-First & Ultra-Fast: Loads in < 250ms with zero heavy bundlers; converts into a smooth bottom-sheet drawer on mobile phones with 48px+ touch targets and zero horizontal scroll overflow.
🏆 Visual Role & Lane Tier List Hub: S+ to D tier buckets filterable by Lane (EXP, Mid, Gold, Roam, Jungle) and Role (Tank, Fighter, Assassin, Mage, Marksman, Support).
📋 High-Density Meta Table: Tabular view with visual win/ban rate bars and sortable columns.
